help: V select, S / K / M place start, controls, finish (stays armed: Esc, V, Enter or right-click leaves), A areas, T text, G gaps on the selected circle or leg. Shift-click or Shift-drag selects several controls; Tab steps through the course, F fits it, double-click a leg to insert. H hides other controls, L toggles the placement loupe, Esc steps back, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo / redo. Map mode: a click selects a map object, Tab the next one under the click, a drag moves it, Delete hides it, H hides the course, F fits the map.
